description: The other half of reserving a word: binding it stays legal. spec/grammar.md:390 is a MUST NOT — an implementation "MUST NOT raise ol-reserved-word — or any other diagnostic — for the name alone" in a binding position — and spec/grammar.md:388 applies it to this word by name: `:global = 1`, `local global` and `set global to 1` "are conforming programs". A `for ... in` binder is checked too, so the guarantee is pinned across four binding forms rather than one.
